title: 第11章 去酒店第12章 狂风暴雨
content_zh:
;;
刘小燕撅起了小嘴巴。
“傻哥，你和她什么关系？你是和我好，还是和她好？”
她这样说，反倒把唐诗逸逗得前仰后合。
“这小妮子太可爱了，一起去我的酒店吧。”
“好。”
唐诗逸让人开着白菜车，把白菜送到了酒店。
陈楚和刘小燕坐着她的豪车，跟着到了酒店。
“陈先生，你这白菜多少钱？”
“不贵，一百块一斤。”
“啥？”刘小燕吓了一跳。
“傻哥，你没发烧吧？”
刘小燕伸手放在他脑门上。
“小燕，我发什么烧啊？”
然后看向唐诗逸。
“诗逸，我这白菜和其他地方的完全不同，你给大客户吃，保准能谈成大生意。”
“嗯，我信你。”
唐诗逸笑了下。
陈楚不仅给她治好了病，还给她大伯从阎王爷那里拉了回来，所以这白菜肯定不凡。
刘小燕撅着小嘴道。

“唐小姐，我傻哥说一百块一斤是和你开玩笑呢，我们农村家的白菜没那么贵，五毛钱一斤……”
然后又劝陈楚。
“傻哥，虽然咱们农村人没啥钱，但是不能昧着良心赚钱，你肯定是开玩笑的对不对？你如果再这样开玩笑，我以后就不理你了。”
唐诗逸不这样认为。
“小姑娘，如果你真喜欢一个男人，就应该选择无条件的相信他，而不是怀疑，陈先生可不是凡人，他哪怕说把天上的星星摘下来，我都会相信的。”
这时候，楼层经理走了过来。
“唐总，一共五百斤白菜，每斤一百块，一共五万块。”
唐诗逸把钱给了陈楚。
“多谢唐总，我先回去了。”
“陈先生，吃过饭再走啊。”
陈楚也不矫情，进入包间。
很快，里面摆了一桌的酒席。
陈楚风卷残云，不知不觉已经消灭了。
一旁小口吃的刘小燕吓得唏嘘。
“傻哥，你咋比以前更能吃了。”
陈楚也觉得，可能是继承了罗刹女衣钵的关系吧，身体强劲，饭量也开始增大。
吃完饭，两人准备离开。
唐诗逸又送过来两个手提袋。
“一点小礼品，不成敬意。”
content_en:
;;
Liu Xiaoyan pursed her lips.
"Silly brother, what's your relationship with her? Are you better with me or her?"
What she said made Tang Shiyi laugh.
"This little girl is so cute, let's go to my hotel together."
"Okay."
Tang Shiyi asked someone to drive a cabbage cart and deliver the cabbage to the hotel.
Chen Chu and Liu Xiaoyan followed her to the hotel in her luxury car.
"Mr. Chen, how much does your cabbage cost?"
"It's not expensive, a hundred yuan a pound."
"What?" Liu Xiaoyan was startled.
"Silly brother, you don't have a fever, do you?"
Liu Xiaoyan put her hand on his forehead.
"Xiaoyan, why do I have a fever?"
Then he looked at Tang Shiyi.
"Shiyi, my cabbage is completely different from the ones from other places. If you feed it to big customers, you can definitely negotiate big business."
"Well, I believe you."
Tang Shiyi smiled.
Chen Chu not only cured her illness, but also helped her uncle get her back from the Lord of Hell, so this cabbage must be extraordinary.
Liu Xiaoyan pouted her lips and said.
"Miss Tang, my silly brother was kidding you when he said one hundred yuan per catty. Cabbage in our rural areas is not that expensive, only fifty cents per catty..."
Then he persuaded Chen Chu.
"Silly brother, although we rural people don't have much money, we can't make money without conscience. You must be joking, right? If you keep joking like this, I will ignore you in the future."
Tang Shiyi doesn't think so.
"Little girl, if you really like a man, you should choose to believe him unconditionally instead of doubting him. Mr. Chen is not a mortal. Even if he says to pick off the stars from the sky, I will believe him."
At this time, the floor manager came over.
"Mr. Tang, there are five hundred catties of cabbage in total, one hundred yuan per catty, a total of fifty thousand yuan."
Tang Shiyi gave the money to Chen Chu.
"Thank you, Mr. Tang. I'll go back first."
"Mr. Chen, please leave after dinner."
Chen Chu didn't show any pretense and entered the private room.
Soon, a banquet table was set up inside.
Chen Chu was swept away by the wind and the remaining clouds were gone before he knew it.
Liu Xiaoyan, who was stuttering on the side, was so frightened that she sighed.
"Silly brother, why are you eating better than before?"
Chen Chu also felt that maybe it was because he had inherited the mantle of the Rakshasa girl. His body was strong and his appetite began to increase.
After eating, the two were ready to leave.
Tang Shiyi sent over two more handbags.
"A small gift is not disrespectful."
